results.title: When Silence Barks
results.overview: At 17, Jérémy dreams of becoming a filmmaker and shares an incredibly close bond with his older brother Théo, a rising rap artist. But the onset of psychotic symptoms throws the family’s fragile balance into turmoil. Amid denial, crises and attempts to create together, the two brothers fight to preserve their bond. Jérémy must learn to accept his illness, live with it, and ultimately let go of the life he had imagined for himself.

results.title: No Hands: The Wild Ride of the Schwinn Bicycle Company
results.original_title: No Hands: The Wild Ride of the Schwinn Bicycle Company
results.overview: Founded in Chicago in 1895, Schwinn grew into an American icon, giving generations of kids their first taste of freedom on two wheels.  Narrated by Lance Armstrong, No Hands traces the company’s extraordinary rise, innovations and mysterious collapse while exploring its influence on childhood, BMX, mountain biking and American culture.  Through family members, cycling pioneers, collectors and industry leaders, the film reveals a story not simply about a bicycle company, but about memory, family, reinvention and what a first bike came to mean in American life.

results.title: TJPW Final Curtain in Kobe Art Center
results.original_title: TJPW Final Curtain in Kobe Art Center
results.overview: TJPW Final Curtain in Kobe Art Center was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on February 21, 2026 at Kobe Art Center in Kobe, Hyōgo, Japan.

results.title: Bersuara Tapi Tak Didengar
results.overview: Zaini, a young lawyer living with Tourette syndrome often becomes a victim of ridicule and discrimination. When he inherits a law firm, he is determined to fight for justice in court. However, his struggle is tested when he becomes the target of a scheming senior lawyer who is jealous of his abilities, forcing him to face public mockery.

results.title: Whatcha Want
results.overview: When a young trophy wife and recent immigrant from Hong Kong uncovers her wealthy husband's betrayal, she reignites her passion for dance, forcing her to choose between the life she was given and the liberation she longs for.

results.title: I See You
results.overview: After his phone breaks, Matvii goes to search for a woman whose life he had been observing through it up until that point, not knowing how she will react if she finds out that he's a wheelchair bound war veteran.

results.title: Our Effed Up World
results.overview: Grieving the recent loss of her grandmother, a young woman and her ragtag group of friends become the town's only defense when a mysterious alien entity crash-lands in the woods with an insatiable hunger.

results.title: Nukkad Naatak
results.overview: After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

results.title: Get Into The Spirit
results.overview: While attempting to communicate with a handsome ghost haunting their house, two husbands discover there are many ways a spirit can reach out from beyond the grave.

results.title: A Marble in the Jar
results.overview: A symbolic practice of consciously acknowledging something positive—no matter how small or large—as a way of deliberately finding the good. This concept is at the heart of the story, which follows the professional surfing journey of Tatiana Weston-Webb. Documenting her upbringing, a heartbreaking loss at a World Title, and her struggle to fight her way back to the top.

results.title: За любовь
results.overview: A couple on the brink of divorce receives a magic bottle that grants wishes, turning their lives upside down.

results.title: Alma Negra, do Quilombo ao Baile
results.original_title: Alma Negra, do Quilombo ao Baile
results.overview: A deep dive into Afro-Brazilian culture, exploring the trajectory of soul music in Brazil from the late 1960s to its peak at "black balls" in the following decades. Through the lens of intellectuals such as Beatriz Nascimento, Lélia Gonzalez, and Edneia Gonçalves, the documentary recovers and celebrates the importance of these parties as spaces of resistance and affirmation of Black identity in Brazil, connecting Quilombola traditions to contemporary urban culture.

results.title: The Feast of the Wolf
results.overview: The wolves are returning to a barren region in the Croatian-Dalmatian hinterland. Though the tourist destinations of the Adriatic coast are less than half an hour away, people in the deserted villages of Bukovica believe that "Brussels" represents evil and flies the wolves over by helicopter. Ana, a dedicated veterinarian, attempts to refute these theories and engage with the people on the ground.

results.title: Poupiya
results.overview: Rachid, a retired colonel and former freedom fighter, mysteriously disappears carrying a rifle from his past, while Djamel, a young man from a working-class neighborhood, sets off on an unexpected night adventure.  On a remote rural road, their paths cross in a strange encounter that unfolds into a series of absurd and comedic situations, where memory collides with reality in a journey full of surprises.

results.title: Bhootam Bhayyam
results.overview: Seven unemployed friends move into a cursed mansion and discover a mysterious coin. Using it in planchette sessions for quick cash, they awaken ancient forces. Now spirits and occultists hunt them as dark secrets emerge.

results.title: ROOSTERS
results.overview: ROOSTERS explores masculinity, legacy, and the cost of absence. When a father returns to reclaim his place, he’s met by the son who already took it.  The rooster isn’t the fight — it’s what they’re fighting for.

results.title: Keepers of Memory: Nature in the Age of Fire
results.original_title: Custodi della memoria. La Natura al tempo del Fuoco
results.overview: Focusing on the catastrophic wildfires in British Columbia, this documentary blends Indigenous wisdom, ambient nature soundscapes, and personal testimonies—including survivors of the 2021 Lytton disaster. The film highlights the deep spiritual connection between humanity and nature, calling for environmental stewardship while exposing the ongoing grief of Indigenous communities stripped of their ancestral lands.

results.title: Richard Strauss: The Woman without a Shadow  @ Aix-en-Provence Festival 2026
results.original_title: Richard Strauss : La femme sans ombre Festival d’Aix-en-Provence 2026
results.overview: After marrying the emperor of the south-eastern islands, the daughter of the king of the spirits lost her magical powers without acquiring the shadow that would seal her place in the human world. Under the baton of Klaus Mäkelä, Barrie Kosky transforms Strauss’s most ambitious opera into an allegory of the awakening of consciousness.
